substrate_material: Glass, annealed titanium foil, silicon wafer
pretreatment: The substrates were placed on the stainless steel holder of dimensions 35 /C2 80 mm placed in the centre of the precisely temperature-controlled chamber. The MoSe2 ALD process started immediately after 5 pulses of ultrapure water, applied to increase the number of hydroxyl active sites on the substrates surface.
surface_functionalization: The substrates surface was treated with ultrapure water to increase the number of hydroxyl active sites.
evidence: The MoSe2 ALD process started immediately after 5 pulses of ultrapure water, applied to increase the number of hydroxyl active sites on the substrates surface.
